7.2 配置回滚API@Service@Slf4jpublic class ConfigRollbackService { @Autowired private NacosConfigManager nacosConfigManager; /** * 查询配置历史版本 */ public List<ConfigHistoryInfo> getConfigHistory(String dataId, String group, String namespace) { try { ConfigService configService = nacosConfigManager.getConfigService(); // Nacos提供历史版本查询API // 每页最多100条，按时间倒序 return queryHistoryFromNacos(dataId, group, namespace); } catch (Exception e) { log.error("查询配置历史失败: {}:{}", dataId, group, e); return Collections.emptyList(); } } /** * 配置回滚 * 智慧矿山场景：错误配置导致告警规则失效，需要紧急回滚 */ public boolean rollback(String dataId, String group, String namespace, long targetVersionId) { try { // 1. 获取目标版本的配置内容 String targetContent = getConfigByVersion(dataId, group, namespace, targetVersionId); if (targetContent == null) { log.error("目标版本不存在: {}", targetVersionId); return false; } // 2. 获取当前配置（用于回滚后对比） String currentContent = nacosConfigManager.getConfigService() .getConfig(dataId, group, 3000); // 3. 发布目标版本的内容（相当于回滚） boolean success = nacosConfigManager.getConfigService() .publishConfig(dataId, group, targetContent); if (success) { log.info("配置回滚成功: {}:{}, 回滚到版本: {}", dataId, group, targetVersionId); // 4. 记录回滚审计日志 auditRollback(dataId, group, currentContent, targetContent); } return success; } catch (Exception e) { log.error("配置回滚失败: {}:{}", dataId, group, e); return false; } } /** * 紧急回滚：配置变更导致服务异常时的快速回滚 */ public boolean emergencyRollback(String dataId, String group, String namespace) { log.warn("紧急回滚触发: {}:{}", dataId, group); try { // 获取上一个稳定版本 List<ConfigHistoryInfo> history = getConfigHistory(dataId, group, namespace); if (history.size() >= 2) { // 第二个版本就是上一次的配置 ConfigHistoryInfo previous = history.get(1); return rollback(dataId, group, namespace, previous.getId()); } log.error("无历史版本可回滚"); return false; } catch (Exception e) { log.error("紧急回滚失败", e); return false; } } private void auditRollback(String dataId, String group, String fromContent, String toContent) { // 审计日志记录 log.info("配置回滚审计 - dataId: {}, group: {}, " + "回滚前长度: {}, 回滚后长度: {}, 时间: {}", dataId, group, fromContent != null ? fromContent.length() : 0, toContent != null ? toContent.length() : 0, LocalDateTime.now()); }}
7.3 配置变更审计/** * 配置变更审计记录 * 实际项目要求：所有生产配置变更必须记录审计日志 */@Component@Slf4jpublic class ConfigAuditRecorder { @Autowired private ConfigAuditRepository auditRepository; /** * 记录配置变更 */ public void recordChange(ConfigChangeEvent event) { ConfigAuditRecord record = new ConfigAuditRecord(); record.setDataId(event.getDataId()); record.setGroup(event.getGroup()); record.setNamespace(event.getNamespace()); record.setOperator(event.getOperator()); record.setOldValue(truncate(event.getOldValue(), 1000)); record.setNewValue(truncate(event.getNewValue(), 1000)); record.setChangeTime(LocalDateTime.now()); record.setSourceIp(event.getSourceIp()); auditRepository.save(record); log.info("配置变更审计记录: {}:{} by {} from {}", event.getDataId(), event.getGroup(), event.getOperator(), event.getSourceIp()); } /** * 查询配置变更历史 */ public Page<ConfigAuditRecord> queryHistory(String dataId, String group, Pageable pageable) { return auditRepository.findByDataIdAndGroupOrderByChangeTimeDesc( dataId, group, pageable); } private String truncate(String value, int maxLength) { if (value == null) return null; return value.length() > maxLength ? value.substring(0, maxLength) + "...(truncated)" : value; }}@Data@Entity@Table(name = "config_audit_record")public class ConfigAuditRecord { @Id @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY) private Long id; private String dataId; private String group; private String namespace; private String operator; @Column(columnDefinition = "TEXT") private String oldValue; @Column(columnDefinition = "TEXT") private String newValue; private LocalDateTime changeTime; private String sourceIp;}
八、配置校验与启动检查8.1 配置校验架构架构流程： flowchart TD N1["配置校验三层防线 第一层启动时校验 ConfigurationProperties"] N2["JSR-303校验"] N3["NotNull, Min, Max, Pattern"] N4["Validated"] N5["自定义校验跨字段校验"] N6["业务规则校验"] N7["校验失败启动报错"] N8["拒绝上线"] N9["ConfigurationProperties"] N10["配置变更监听器"] N11["值范围检查"] N12["变更值超出范围"] N13["告警"] N14["拒绝变更"] N15["必要配置缺失"] N16["使用默认值"] N17["配置发布前校验YAML格式检查"] N18["必填项检查"] N19["格式错误"] N20["拒绝发布"] N1 --> N2 N1 --> N3 N4 --> N2 N4 --> N3 N2 --> N5 N2 --> N6 N3 --> N5 N3 --> N6 N5 --> N7 N5 --> N8 N6 --> N7 N6 --> N8 N7 --> N9 N7 --> N4 N8 --> N9 N8 --> N4 N9 --> N2 N9 --> N3 N7 --> N10 N7 --> N11 N8 --> N10 N8 --> N11 N10 --> N12 N11 --> N12 N12 --> N13 N12 --> N14 N13 --> N15 N14 --> N15 N15 --> N13 N15 --> N16 N13 --> N17 N13 --> N18 N16 --> N17 N16 --> N18 N17 --> N19 N18 --> N19 N19 --> N20
8.2 启动时配置校验/** * 启动时配置完整性校验 * 确保关键配置项存在且值合法 * 智慧矿山场景：数据库、Redis、MQ等基础配置缺失会导致服务不可用 */@Component@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "smart-mine")@Validated@Getter@Setterpublic class SmartMineConfig { /** 数据库配置 */ @NotNull(message = "数据库主机地址不能为空") private String dbHost; @NotNull(message = "数据库端口不能为空") @Min(value = 1, message = "数据库端口不合法") @Max(value = 65535, message = "数据库端口不合法") private Integer dbPort; @NotNull(message = "数据库名称不能为空") private String dbName; /** 设备通信配置 */ @NotNull(message = "设备通信协议不能为空") @Pattern(regexp = "^(TCP|UDP|MODBUS|OPC-UA)$", message = "不支持的设备通信协议") private String deviceProtocol; @Min(value = 1, message = "设备采集间隔不能小于1秒") @Max(value = 3600, message = "设备采集间隔不能大于3600秒") private int deviceCollectInterval = 5; /** 告警配置 */ @NotNull(message = "告警通知方式不能为空") private List<@NotBlank String> alertNotifyTypes; @DecimalMin(value = "0.01", message = "瓦斯浓度阈值必须大于0.01%") @DecimalMax(value = "5.0", message = "瓦斯浓度阈值不能超过5.0%") private BigDecimal gasThreshold = new BigDecimal("1.0"); /** 线程池配置 */ @Min(value = 1, message = "核心线程数不能小于1") @Max(value = 200, message = "核心线程数不能大于200") private int threadPoolCoreSize = 10; @Min(value = 1, message = "最大线程数不能小于1") @Max(value = 500, message = "最大线程数不能大于500") private int threadPoolMaxSize = 50; /** 跨字段校验 */ @AssertTrue(message = "核心线程数不能大于最大线程数") private boolean isValidThreadPool() { return threadPoolCoreSize <= threadPoolMaxSize; }}
8.3 启动必要配置检查/** * 启动时检查必要配置是否存在 * 如果关键配置缺失，拒绝启动 */@Component@Slf4jpublic class RequiredConfigChecker implements ApplicationRunner { @Autowired private Environment environment; /** 必须存在的配置项列表 */ private static final List<String> REQUIRED_CONFIGS = List.of( "spring.datasource.url", "spring.datasource.username", "spring.datasource.password", "spring.redis.host", "smart-mine.device-protocol", "smart-mine.gas-threshold" ); @Override public void run(ApplicationArguments args) { log.info("开始检查必要配置项..."); List<String> missingConfigs = new ArrayList<>(); for (String configKey : REQUIRED_CONFIGS) { String value = environment.getProperty(configKey); if (value == null || value.trim().isEmpty()) { missingConfigs.add(configKey); log.error("必要配置缺失: {}", configKey); } } if (!missingConfigs.isEmpty()) { String errorMsg = "必要配置缺失，拒绝启动！缺失项: " + missingConfigs; log.error(errorMsg); throw new IllegalStateException(errorMsg); } log.info("必要配置项检查通过，共检查{}项", REQUIRED_CONFIGS.size()); }}
8.4 配置变更值范围校验/** * 配置变更值范围校验器 * 防止运维人员配置异常值 * 智慧矿山场景：瓦斯阈值配成0会导致持续告警，配成100会导致不告警 */@Component@Slf4jpublic class ConfigValueValidator { /** 配置值范围约束 */ private static final Map<String, ValueRange> CONFIG_RANGES = Map.of( "device.max-retry", new ValueRange(1, 10, "重试次数"), "device.timeout", new ValueRange(1000, 60000, "超时时间(ms)"), "device.collect-interval", new ValueRange(1, 3600, "采集间隔(秒)"), "smart-mine.gas-threshold", new ValueRange(0.01, 5.0, "瓦斯浓度阈值(%)"), "smart-mine.thread-pool-core-size", new ValueRange(1, 200, "核心线程数") ); /** * 校验配置值是否在合法范围内 * @return 校验结果 */ public ValidationResult validate(String key, String value) { ValueRange range = CONFIG_RANGES.get(key); if (range == null) { return ValidationResult.ok(); // 不在约束范围内的配置不校验 } try { double numValue = Double.parseDouble(value); if (numValue < range.min || numValue > range.max) { String msg = String.format("配置值超出范围: %s = %s, 合法范围: %s~%s (%s)", key, value, range.min, range.max, range.description); log.error(msg); return ValidationResult.fail(msg); } return ValidationResult.ok(); } catch (NumberFormatException e) { String msg = String.format("配置值格式错误: %s = %s, 期望数字", key, value); log.error(msg); return ValidationResult.fail(msg); } } @Data @AllArgsConstructor private static class ValueRange { private double min; private double max; private String description; } @Data @AllArgsConstructor public static class ValidationResult { private boolean valid; private String message; public static ValidationResult ok() { return new ValidationResult(true, "校验通过"); } public static ValidationResult fail(String message) { return new ValidationResult(false, message); } }}

9.2 配置命名规范Data ID命名规范：主配置：${spring.application.name}.${file-extension} 例：device-service.yaml共享配置：common-${组件名}.yaml 例：common-db.yaml, common-redis.yaml, common-mq.yaml领域配置：${领域}-common.yaml 例：device-common.yaml, alert-common.yaml灰度配置：${应用名}-gray.yaml 例：device-service-gray.yaml环境差异配置：${应用名}-${profile}.yaml 例：device-service-prod.yaml（仅生产特有配置）Group命名规范：SHARED - 全局共享配置MICRO_SERVICE - 微服务应用配置DOMAIN_SHARED - 领域共享配置GRAY - 灰度配置THIRD_PARTY - 第三方服务配置
9.3 配置变更SOP配置变更标准操作流程（实际项目）：Step 1: 变更评估 → 变更范围：哪些服务受影响？ → 变更风险：是否影响安全相关配置？ → 回滚方案：当前配置值是什么？如何回滚？Step 2: 变更审批 → 普通配置：开发负责人审批 → 安全相关配置（告警阈值等）：架构师+安全负责人审批 → 数据库配置：DBA审批Step 3: 通知相关方 → 变更前30分钟通知运维团队 → 变更前10分钟通知监控值班人员 → 通知内容：变更什么、何时变更、可能影响Step 4: 灰度发布（必须） → 先发布到灰度实例 → 观察5~10分钟 → 检查日志、指标、业务功能Step 5: 全量发布 → 灰度验证通过后全量发布 → 持续观察5~10分钟Step 6: 确认与记录 → 确认所有实例配置已生效 → 记录变更审计日志 → 更新配置文档紧急变更： → 跳过Step 2/3，但仍需灰度发布 → 事后补审批 → 24小时内复盘
9.4 配置项设计原则
原则 说明 反例 正例
必须有默认值 缺省时使用合理默认值 @Value("${db.url}") @Value("${db.url:localhost:3306}")
命名有层次 用前缀区分归属 retry, timeout device.retry, device.timeout
类型明确 使用强类型而非字符串 timeout=5000 用@ConfigurationProperties绑定int
变更可感知 重要变更触发通知 静默变更 配置变更→日志+告警
加密敏感值 密码密钥加密存储 password=abc123 password=ENC(xxx)
环境隔离 不同环境不同Namespace 用profile区分 每个环境独立Namespace
可回滚 每次变更保留历史 覆盖无记录 Nacos自动保留30天历史
防误操作 生产配置写保护 任何人可改 生产Namespace限制写权限
十、Nacos集群部署10.1 Nacos集群架构架构流程： flowchart TD N1["Nacos 生产集群部署"] N2["Nacos-1 Nacos-2"] N3["Nacos-3 8848 8848"] N4["8848 (Leader)"] N5["(Follower)"] N6["Nacos-1"] N7["Nacos-2 Nacos-3 8848"] N8["8848 8848 (Leader)"] N9["MySQL 主从集群 nacos库"] N1 --> N2 N1 --> N3 N1 --> N4 N1 --> N5 N6 --> N2 N6 --> N3 N6 --> N4 N6 --> N5 N7 --> N2 N7 --> N3 N7 --> N4 N7 --> N5 N8 --> N2 N8 --> N3 N8 --> N4 N8 --> N5 N5 --> N2 N5 --> N3 N5 --> N4 N2 --> N9 N3 --> N9 N4 --> N9 N5 --> N9
10.2 Nacos集群配置# application.properties (Nacos Server)# 集群配置nacos.member.list=nacos1:8848,nacos2:8848,nacos3:8848# 数据库配置（外置MySQL）spring.datasource.platform=mysqldb.num=1db.url.0=jdbc:mysql://mysql-master:3306/nacos?characterEncoding=utf8&connectTimeout=1000&socketTimeout=3000&autoReconnect=true&useUnicode=true&useSSL=false&serverTimezone=Asia/Shanghaidb.user.0=nacosdb.password.0=ENC(encrypted_password)# 2.x gRPC配置nacos.core.protocol.raft.data.enabled=truenacos.core.protocol.raft.data.self_addr=nacos1:7848nacos.core.protocol.raft.data.cluster_members=nacos1:7848,nacos2:7848,nacos3:7848# 鉴权配置nacos.core.auth.enabled=truenacos.core.auth.server.identity.key=serverIdentitynacos.core.auth.server.identity.value=securitynacos.core.auth.plugin.nacos.token.secret.key=SecretKey012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789# 配置持久化nacos.config.retention.days=30 # 配置保留30天nacos.config.max-aggr-size-kb=1024 # 聚合配置最大1MBnacos.config.max-content-size-kb=1024 # 单条配置最大1MB
10.3 Nacos集群监控指标
指标 告警阈值 说明
nacos_leader_status not LEADER 集群无Leader
config_publish_count 短时间激增 配置发布频率异常
config_get_count QPS > 10000 配置拉取压力
long_polling_count > 50000 长轮询连接数
nacos_exception_total > 100/min Nacos异常数
mysql_connect_error > 0 MySQL连接失败
raft_election_timeout > 0 Raft选举超时
# Nacos集群健康检查脚本#!/bin/bashfor host in nacos1 nacos2 nacos3; do echo "=== $host ===" # 检查集群状态 curl -s "http://$host:8848/nacos/v1/ns/operator/leaders" | jq . # 检查Raft状态 curl -s "http://$host:8848/nacos/v1/ns/raft/state" | jq .done# 检查配置数量curl -s "http://nacos1:8848/nacos/v1/cs/configs?search=accurate&dataId=&group=&pageNo=1&pageSize=10" | jq '.totalCount'
十一、源码分析：配置加载与刷新核心流程11.1 NacosConfigService初始化/** * NacosConfigService 初始化流程 * 这是Nacos客户端配置加载的入口 */public class NacosConfigService implements ConfigService { private NacosConfigProperties properties; private ConfigFilterChainManager configFilterChainManager; private ClientWorker clientWorker; // 核心工作类：负责配置拉取和监听 public NacosConfigService(Properties properties) throws NacosException { // 1. 初始化配置过滤器链 this.configFilterChainManager = new ConfigFilterChainManager(properties); // 2. 初始化Server配置 ServerListManager serverListManager = new ServerListManager(properties); // 3. 创建ClientWorker（核心） // Nacos 2.x: 使用gRPC长连接 // Nacos 1.x: 使用HTTP长轮询 this.clientWorker = new ClientWorker(serverListManager, properties); } /** * 获取配置 * 优先从本地缓存获取，不存在则从Server拉取 */ @Override public String getConfig(String dataId, String group, long timeoutMs) throws NacosException { // 1. 先查本地缓存 ConfigResponse response = configFilterChainManager.doFilter( new ConfigRequest(dataId, group)); // 2. 缓存miss，从Server拉取 if (response.getContent() == null) { String content = clientWorker.getServerConfig(dataId, group, timeoutMs); // 3. 保存到本地快照 saveSnapshot(dataId, group, content); return content; } return response.getContent(); } /** * 添加配置监听器 * 注册到ClientWorker，由ClientWorker负责变更通知 */ @Override public void addListener(String dataId, String group, Listener listener) { // 注册到ClientWorker的监听器缓存 clientWorker.addListeners(dataId, group, Collections.singletonList(listener)); }}
11.2 ClientWorker长轮询机制（Nacos 1.x）/** * ClientWorker 长轮询核心逻辑 * Nacos 1.x使用HTTP长轮询检测配置变更 */public class ClientWorker { // 配置变更监听器缓存 private final ConcurrentHashMap<String, CacheData> cacheMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(); // 长轮询执行器 private final ScheduledExecutorService executor; public ClientWorker(ServerListManager serverListManager, Properties properties) { // 初始化定时任务：分为长轮询和配置拉取两个线程 this.executor = Executors.newScheduledThreadPool(2, new ThreadFactoryBuilder().setNameFormat("nacos-client-worker-%d").build()); // 长轮询任务：每10ms检查一次是否有配置变更需要探测 this.executor.scheduleWithFixedDelay( new LongPollingRunnable(), 0L, 10L, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS); } /** * 长轮询核心逻辑 */ class LongPollingRunnable implements Runnable { @Override public void run() { // 1. 收集所有需要检查的配置 List<CacheData> cacheDataList = new ArrayList<>(cacheMap.values()); // 2. 构建长轮询请求 // 将所有dataId+group发送到Server，Server检查是否有变更 // 如果没有变更，Server挂起请求最多30秒 // 如果有变更，Server立即返回变更的dataId列表 List<String> changedGroupKeys = checkConfigInfo(cacheDataList); // 3. 对变更的配置，从Server拉取最新内容 for (String groupKey : changedGroupKeys) { String[] key = GroupKey.parseKey(groupKey); String content = getServerConfig(key[0], key[1], 3000L); // 4. 更新本地缓存 CacheData cacheData = cacheMap.get(groupKey); cacheData.setContent(content); // 5. 通知监听器 for (Listener listener : cacheData.getListeners()) { listener.receiveConfigInfo(content); } } } /** * 发送长轮询请求 * 请求参数：所有配置的dataId+group+md5 * Server端：如果md5不变则挂起，md5变化则返回变更列表 */ private List<String> checkConfigInfo(List<CacheData> cacheDataList) { // 构建请求体：dataId|group|md5 StringBuilder params = new StringBuilder(); for (CacheData cacheData : cacheDataList) { params.append(cacheData.getDataId()).append("|") .append(cacheData.getGroup()).append("|") .append(cacheData.getMd5()).append(";"); } // 发送HTTP长轮询请求 // Server端如果md5都没变，则挂起最多30秒 // 如果有变化，立即返回变化的key列表 return proxy.compareConfig(params.toString()); } }}
11.3 Nacos 2.x gRPC长连接/** * Nacos 2.x 配置变更通知机制 * 使用gRPC长连接替代HTTP长轮询 * 配置变更推送延迟从秒级降低到毫秒级 */public class NacosConfigGrpcClient { private GrpcConnection grpcConnection; /** * 建立gRPC连接 * 连接建立后，Server端配置变更会实时推送到客户端 */ public void connect(String serverAddr) { ManagedChannel channel = ManagedChannelBuilder .forTarget(serverAddr) .usePlaintext() .build(); // 创建双向流 // 客户端可以发送请求，服务端可以主动推送 this.grpcConnection = new GrpcConnection(channel); } /** * 配置变更推送处理 * Server端配置变更后，通过gRPC推送ChangeNotice */ public void onConfigChange(ChangeNotice notice) { String dataId = notice.getDataId(); String group = notice.getGroup(); String content = notice.getContent(); // 1. 更新本地缓存 CacheData cacheData = cacheMap.get(GroupKey.getKey(dataId, group)); cacheData.setContent(content); // 2. 通知所有监听器 for (Listener listener : cacheData.getListeners()) { listener.receiveConfigInfo(content); } // 3. 触发Spring Cloud RefreshEvent // → RefreshScope Bean销毁重建 applicationContext.publishEvent( new RefreshEvent(this, null, "Nacos config changed")); }}
十二、项目实践：配置中心运维平台12.1 配置中心运维平台架构架构流程： flowchart TD N1["配置中心运维平台"] N2["运维控制台"] N3["配置管理"] N4["灰度发布 版本回滚"] N5["配置管理 灰度发布 版本回滚"] N6["变更审计 值校验 监控告警"] N7["配置变更流水线 提交变更"] N8["自动校验"] N9["审批"] N10["灰度发布"] N11["验证"] N12["全量"] N13["Nacos Server"] N1 --> N2 N1 --> N3 N1 --> N4 N2 --> N3 N2 --> N4 N3 --> N2 N3 --> N4 N4 --> N2 N4 --> N3 N2 --> N5 N3 --> N5 N4 --> N5 N5 --> N6 N6 --> N7 N7 --> N8 N8 --> N9 N9 --> N10 N10 --> N11 N11 --> N12 N12 --> N13
12.2 配置变更流水线/** * 配置变更流水线 * 标准化配置变更流程，降低人为操作风险 */@Service@Slf4jpublic class ConfigChangePipeline { @Autowired private ConfigValueValidator configValueValidator; @Autowired private ConfigAuditRecorder auditRecorder; @Autowired private GrayConfigService grayConfigService; @Autowired private NacosConfigManager nacosConfigManager; /** * 执行配置变更流水线 */ public ChangeResult execute(ChangeRequest request) { log.info("开始配置变更流水线: {}:{}", request.getDataId(), request.getGroup()); // Step 1: 格式校验 ValidationResult formatResult = validateFormat(request); if (!formatResult.isValid()) { return ChangeResult.fail("格式校验失败: " + formatResult.getMessage()); } // Step 2: 值范围校验 ValidationResult valueResult = validateValues(request); if (!valueResult.isValid()) { return ChangeResult.fail("值范围校验失败: " + valueResult.getMessage()); } // Step 3: 灰度发布 boolean grayResult = grayConfigService.publishGrayConfig( request.getDataId(), request.getGroup(), request.getNewContent()); if (!grayResult) { return ChangeResult.fail("灰度发布失败"); } // Step 4: 等待灰度验证 boolean verified = waitForGrayVerification(request); if (!verified) { // 灰度验证失败，自动回滚 grayConfigService.emergencyRollback( request.getDataId(), request.getGroup(), request.getNamespace()); return ChangeResult.fail("灰度验证失败，已自动回滚"); } // Step 5: 全量发布 boolean fullResult = grayConfigService.publishFullConfig( request.getDataId(), request.getGroup(), request.getNewContent()); if (!fullResult) { return ChangeResult.fail("全量发布失败"); } // Step 6: 记录审计日志 auditRecorder.recordChange(toEvent(request)); log.info("配置变更流水线执行完成: {}:{}", request.getDataId(), request.getGroup()); return ChangeResult.ok("配置变更成功"); } private ValidationResult validateFormat(ChangeRequest request) { try { Yaml yaml = new Yaml(); yaml.load(request.getNewContent()); return ValidationResult.ok(); } catch (Exception e) { return ValidationResult.fail("YAML格式错误: " + e.getMessage()); } } private ValidationResult validateValues(ChangeRequest request) { // 解析新配置，逐key校验值范围 YamlPropertiesFactoryBean factory = new YamlPropertiesFactoryBean(); factory.setResources(new ByteArrayResource(request.getNewContent().getBytes())); Properties props = factory.getObject(); for (String key : props.stringPropertyNames()) { ValidationResult result = configValueValidator.validate(key, props.getProperty(key)); if (!result.isValid()) { return result; } } return ValidationResult.ok(); } private boolean waitForGrayVerification(ChangeRequest request) { // 等待灰度实例验证（简化实现） // 实际项目中需要对接监控系统检查灰度实例的健康状态 try { Thread.sleep(60000); // 等待1分钟 return true; } catch (InterruptedException e) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return false; } }}
十三、Nacos配置中心与Spring Cloud生态集成13.1 集成架构架构流程： flowchart TD N1["Spring Cloud"] N2["Spring Cloud Gateway (路由配置从Nacos加载"] N3["动态刷新)"] N4["设备服务 告警服务 人员服务"] N5["device alert"] N6["personnel service"] N7["service service"] N8["Nacos Config"] N9["Discovery (配置中心"] N10["服务注册发现)"] N11["Sentinel (限流熔断) (规则从Nacos加载"] N12["动态推送)"] N13["Seata (分布式事务)"] N14["(事务配置从Nacos加载)"] N1 --> N2 N1 --> N3 N2 --> N4 N2 --> N5 N2 --> N6 N2 --> N7 N3 --> N4 N3 --> N5 N3 --> N6 N3 --> N7 N4 --> N8 N4 --> N9 N4 --> N10 N5 --> N8 N5 --> N9 N5 --> N10 N6 --> N8 N6 --> N9 N6 --> N10 N7 --> N8 N7 --> N9 N7 --> N10 N8 --> N11 N8 --> N12 N9 --> N11 N9 --> N12 N10 --> N11 N10 --> N12 N11 --> N13 N11 --> N14 N12 --> N13 N12 --> N14
13.2 Nacos Config依赖配置<!-- pom.xml --><dependencyManagement> <dependencies> <dependency> <groupId>com.alibaba.cloud</groupId> <artifactId>spring-cloud-alibaba-dependencies</artifactId> <version>2022.0.0.0</version> <type>pom</type> <scope>import</scope> </dependency> </dependencies></dependencyManagement><dependencies> <!-- Nacos Config --> <dependency> <groupId>com.alibaba.cloud</groupId> <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-alibaba-nacos-config</artifactId> </dependency> <!-- Nacos Discovery --> <dependency> <groupId>com.alibaba.cloud</groupId> <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-alibaba-nacos-discovery</artifactId> </dependency> <!-- Spring Cloud Bootstrap (Spring Boot 2.4+需要) --> <dependency> <groupId>org.springframework.cloud</groupId> <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-bootstrap</artifactId> </dependency> <!-- Jasypt加密 --> <dependency> <groupId>com.github.ulisesbocchio</groupId> <artifactId>jasypt-spring-boot-starter</artifactId> <version>3.0.5</version> </dependency> <!-- Sentinel --> <dependency> <groupId>com.alibaba.cloud</groupId> <artifactId>spring-cloud-starter-alibaba-sentinel</artifactId> </dependency></dependencies>
13.3 Sentinel规则从Nacos加载# sentinel-nacos.yaml - Sentinel规则配置spring: cloud: sentinel: transport: dashboard: sentinel-dashboard:8080 datasource: # 限流规则从Nacos加载 flow: nacos: server-addr: ${NACOS_ADDR:localhost:8848} namespace: ${NACOS_NAMESPACE:dev} group-id: SENTINEL data-id: ${spring.application.name}-flow-rules.json rule-type: flow # 熔断规则从Nacos加载 degrade: nacos: server-addr: ${NACOS_ADDR:localhost:8848} namespace: ${NACOS_NAMESPACE:dev} group-id: SENTINEL data-id: ${spring.application.name}-degrade-rules.json rule-type: degrade # 系统规则从Nacos加载 system: nacos: server-addr: ${NACOS_ADDR:localhost:8848} namespace: ${NACOS_NAMESPACE:dev} group-id: SENTINEL data-id: ${spring.application.name}-system-rules.json rule-type: system
// device-service-flow-rules.json (Nacos中存储)[ { "resource": "GET:/api/device/{id}", "limitApp": "default", "grade": 1, "count": 100, "strategy": 0, "controlBehavior": 0, "clusterMode": false }, { "resource": "GET:/api/device/list", "limitApp": "default", "grade": 1, "count": 50, "strategy": 0, "controlBehavior": 2, "clusterMode": false }]
十四、常见项目问题与解决方案
序号 问题 现象 原因 解决方案
1 dev配置误推到production 生产环境连接了测试数据库，业务数据写入错误库 运维在Nacos控制台切换Namespace时操作失误，将dev配置发布到production Namespace写权限隔离；生产Namespace只允许特定账号操作；发布前确认Namespace提示
2 @RefreshScope导致NPE 配置刷新后Bean方法调用抛NullPointerException @RefreshScope Bean被非@RefreshScope Bean依赖，刷新时代理对象失效 使用方也加@RefreshScope；或改用事件驱动方式读取配置，不直接注入Bean
3 共享配置修改引发级联故障 修改common-db.yaml后多个服务同时重建连接池，数据库连接数瞬间打满 共享配置变更推送到所有订阅服务，同时触发连接池重建 共享配置变更增加防抖；连接池重建增加随机延迟；分批推送变更
4 配置文件YAML格式错误导致启动失败 服务启动报YamlParseException，整行报错无法定位 Nacos控制台编辑配置时缩进错误，但未做格式校验 控制台发布前YAML格式校验；CI/CD流水线集成yamllint；发布前预检查
5 Nacos Server不可用时服务无法启动 Nacos集群故障，所有微服务启动失败 默认配置fail-fast=true，Nacos不可用直接报错 设置spring.cloud.nacos.config.fail-fast=false；配置本地快照兜底；Nacos集群高可用部署
6 @Value不支持List/Map类型动态刷新 配置中List类型值变更后@Value仍返回旧值 @Value对复杂类型支持有限，需要特殊EL表达式 改用@ConfigurationProperties绑定复杂类型；或自定义Converter
7 配置刷新顺序不确定 有时先刷新共享配置再刷新应用配置，有时相反，导致中间状态异常 Nacos对不同配置集的监听器触发顺序不确定 配置变更监听器中做合并校验，避免依赖刷新顺序；使用防抖合并短时间内的多次刷新
8 Jasypt密钥泄露 生产数据库密码被明文获取 Jasypt密钥硬编码在bootstrap.yml中并提交到Git 密钥通过K8s Secret注入；不同环境使用不同密钥；密钥定期轮换
9 配置回滚后部分实例未生效 回滚后3个实例中2个恢复，1个仍使用错误配置 1个实例gRPC连接异常，未收到回滚通知 健康检查确认所有实例配置已更新；增加配置版本号校验；客户端定期主动拉取对比
10 灰度配置全量发布后灰度实例未清理 灰度实例仍加载灰度配置，行为与其他实例不一致 全量发布后未清理灰度标记和灰度配置文件 全量发布SOP中包含灰度清理步骤；自动化脚本清理灰度标记；灰度配置加TTL自动过期
11 配置变更频率过高导致Bean反复重建 5分钟内修改了3次配置，每次都触发@RefreshScope Bean销毁重建 无防抖机制，每次变更都触发刷新 配置变更防抖（500ms内合并）；重要Bean避免@RefreshScope，改用事件驱动更新
12 bootstrap.yml在Spring Boot 2.4+不生效 使用Spring Boot 2.4+后Nacos配置不加载 Spring Boot 2.4+默认不加载bootstrap.yml 添加spring-cloud-starter-bootstrap依赖；或改用spring.config.import方式
13 Nacos客户端内存泄漏 长时间运行后应用老年代持续增长 监听器每次注册都创建新线程，未复用；CacheData对象持续增长 监听器复用共享Executor；定期检查cacheMap大小；升级到Nacos 2.x使用gRPC
14 配置加密后无法在Nacos控制台预览 ENC(…)格式的值在控制台显示为密文，无法确认明文是否正确 控制台不具备解密能力，只展示原始值 开发加解密工具页面；配置发布前本地验证；审计日志记录明文（脱敏）
15 多服务共享配置中的某个服务不需要某项 共享配置包含MQ配置，但device-service不需要MQ 共享配置粒度太粗，所有服务被迫加载不需要的配置 共享配置按领域细分；不使用的配置项不报错但忽略；服务特定配置覆盖共享配置
十五、总结Nacos配置中心在实际项目中的深度实践，核心要点如下：
多环境隔离：使用Namespace实现开发/测试/预发/生产环境的物理隔离，共享配置用SHARED Group统一管理，敏感配置加密存储，杜绝环境串用的风险 动态刷新原理：理解@RefreshScope的本质是Bean销毁重建而非字段修改，避免在构造函数中使用@Value、避免非@RefreshScope Bean依赖@RefreshScope Bean导致的NPE 配置变更监听：NacosConfigManager监听精确控制变更处理逻辑，Spring Event实现松耦合通知，配置变更防抖避免频繁刷新 灰度配置发布：Nacos 2.x Beta发布实现灰度推送，严格遵循评估-审批-灰度-验证-全量的SOP流程，确保配置变更安全可控 加密存储：Jasypt集成实现敏感配置加密，密钥通过K8s Secret注入，不同环境使用不同密钥 配置回滚：Nacos保留30天历史版本，支持快速回滚；紧急回滚与审计日志记录确保配置变更可追溯 配置校验：启动时JSR-303校验确保配置完整性，运行时值范围校验防止异常值，三层防线确保配置安全
配置中心不只是存配置，更是微服务运行时的管控中枢。配置变更是高风险操作，每一次修改都应该被敬畏：做最坏的打算，做最好的准备，灰度验证是底线，回滚预案是保障。

entry.title: Prometheus与Grafana监控体系——系统健康的仪表盘
entry.content:
前言在实际场景中，SkyWalking解决了链路追踪问题，但系统层面的监控还是一片空白：井下设备服务的CPU飙高不知道、矿车调度模块的内存泄漏不知道、告警推送的线程池满了不知道、传感器数据采集接口的超时率飙升不知道。直到某次生产事故——3#采区32台设备数据采集中断2小时才被用户投诉发现——我们痛定思痛，决定从零搭建Prometheus+Grafana监控体系。 Prometheus负责采集和存储时序指标，Grafana负责可视化展示，AlertManager负责告警通知，三者组合让系统健康状态一目了然。本文将结合实际项目实战经验，从架构设计、指标采集、告警规则、可视化面板到源码分析，全面深入讲解监控体系的落地全过程。
一、监控体系架构1.1 整体架构图架构流程： flowchart TD N1["应用层"] N2["device-data-"] N3["alert-push-"] N4["mine-car- safety-"] N5["service service"] N6["dispatch-svc"] N7["monitor-svc"] N8["Actuator Actuator"] N9["Micrometer"] N10["MEM"] N11["DISK) (慢查询"] N12["连接) (内存"] N13["连接)"] N14["消费率) (服务发现) Exporter(探针)"] N15["AlertManager"] N16["Recording (告警路由分发)"] N17["Rules"] N18["钉钉"] N19["短信"] N20["邮件 (指标预计算)"] N21["QPS 堆内存"] N22["GC 设备在线率 CPU"] N23["内存"] N24["磁盘 错误率"] N25["RT 线程"] N26["类加载 告警推送量 网络"] N27["IO"] N28["队列 慢查询"] N29["QPS 内存"] N30["命中率 Lag"] N31["消费速率"] N1 --> N2 N1 --> N3 N1 --> N4 N1 --> N5 N1 --> N6 N1 --> N7 N1 --> N8 N1 --> N9 N2 --> N3 N2 --> N4 N2 --> N5 N2 --> N6 N2 --> N7 N2 --> N8 N2 --> N9 N3 --> N2 N3 --> N4 N3 --> N5 N3 --> N6 N3 --> N7 N3 --> N8 N3 --> N9 N4 --> N2 N4 --> N3 N4 --> N5 N4 --> N6 N4 --> N7 N4 --> N8 N4 --> N9 N5 --> N2 N5 --> N3 N5 --> N4 N5 --> N6 N5 --> N7 N5 --> N8 N5 --> N9 N6 --> N2 N6 --> N3 N6 --> N4 N6 --> N5 N6 --> N7 N6 --> N8 N6 --> N9 N7 --> N2 N7 --> N3 N7 --> N4 N7 --> N5 N7 --> N6 N7 --> N8 N7 --> N9 N8 --> N2 N8 --> N3 N8 --> N4 N8 --> N5 N8 --> N6 N8 --> N7 N8 --> N9 N9 --> N2 N9 --> N3 N9 --> N4 N9 --> N5 N9 --> N6 N9 --> N7 N9 --> N8 N8 --> N10 N8 --> N11 N8 --> N12 N8 --> N13 N9 --> N10 N9 --> N11 N9 --> N12 N9 --> N13 N10 --> N11 N10 --> N12 N10 --> N13 N11 --> N10 N11 --> N12 N11 --> N13 N12 --> N10 N12 --> N11 N12 --> N13 N13 --> N10 N13 --> N11 N13 --> N12 N10 --> N14 N11 --> N14 N12 --> N14 N13 --> N14 N14 --> N15 N14 --> N16 N14 --> N17 N15 --> N18 N15 --> N19 N15 --> N20 N16 --> N18 N16 --> N19 N16 --> N20 N17 --> N18 N17 --> N19 N17 --> N20 N18 --> N21 N18 --> N22 N18 --> N23 N18 --> N24 N18 --> N25 N18 --> N26 N18 --> N27 N19 --> N21 N19 --> N22 N19 --> N23 N19 --> N24 N19 --> N25 N19 --> N26 N19 --> N27 N20 --> N21 N20 --> N22 N20 --> N23 N20 --> N24 N20 --> N25 N20 --> N26 N20 --> N27 N21 --> N22 N21 --> N23 N21 --> N24 N21 --> N25 N21 --> N26 N21 --> N27 N22 --> N21 N22 --> N23 N22 --> N24 N22 --> N25 N22 --> N26 N22 --> N27 N23 --> N21 N23 --> N22 N23 --> N24 N23 --> N25 N23 --> N26 N23 --> N27 N24 --> N21 N24 --> N22 N24 --> N23 N24 --> N25 N24 --> N26 N24 --> N27 N25 --> N21 N25 --> N22 N25 --> N23 N25 N21 --> N30 N21 --> N31 N22 --> N28 N22 --> N29 N22 --> N30 N22 --> N31 N23 --> N28 N23 --> N29 N23 --> N30 N23 --> N31 N24 --> N28 N24 --> N29 N24 --> N30 N24 --> N31 N25 --> N28 N25 --> N29 N25 --> 1.2 核心组件职责对比
组件 职责 数据流方向 核心特性 实际项目角色
Prometheus Server 指标采集与存储 Pull拉取 → TSDB存储 多维数据模型(PromQL)、高效压缩、联邦集群 核心采集引擎，3节点高可用部署
Exporters 暴露被监控组件的指标 被动暴露 → Prometheus拉取 Node/MySQL/Redis/Kafka等多种Exporter 中间件和基础设施指标统一出口
Pushgateway 短生命周期任务指标推送 Push推送 → Prometheus拉取 支持临时任务、批处理任务指标 矿山数据批量计算任务指标中转
AlertManager 告警路由、去重、分组、抑制 Prometheus推送 → 通知渠道 分组、抑制、静默、路由 告警统一分发至钉钉/短信/电话
Grafana 数据可视化 查询Prometheus → 渲染面板 丰富的图表类型、模板变量、告警 全局监控大盘、各模块细分面板
Consul 服务发现 注册 → Prometheus订阅 健康检查、KV存储 微服务自动注册，Prometheus动态发现
1.3 Prometheus与其他监控方案对比
特性 Prometheus Zabbix Open-Falcon Datadog InfluxDB+Telegraf
数据模型 多维标签（Label） 键值对（Item） 标签+计数器 标签+字段 标签+字段
查询语言 PromQL（强大） 自定义表达式 简单表达式 自定义查询 InfluxQL/Flux
采集方式 Pull（拉取式） Push+Pull Push Agent Push Push+Pull
存储 本地TSDB 关系型数据库 Redis+MySQL 云端存储 本地TSDB
扩展性 联邦集群+远程写入 Proxy分布式 扩展模块 云原生 集群模式
告警 AlertManager（独立） 内置 内置 内置 内置
生态 CNCF，K8s原生 传统运维 小米开源 SaaS商业 TICK生态
适用场景 云原生/微服务 传统IT基础设施 大规模互联网 商业SaaS IoT/时序数据
智慧矿山选型 首选 不推荐 备选 不推荐 不推荐
选型理由：实际项目基于Spring Cloud微服务架构，服务实例数量多且动态变化，Prometheus的Pull模式+Consul服务发现天然契合；PromQL强大的多维查询能力满足了复杂的业务监控需求；CNCF生态与K8s部署无缝衔接。
二、Spring Boot接入Prometheus2.1 依赖与配置Maven依赖： <!-- Micrometer核心 - 指标门面，屏蔽不同监控系统的差异 --><dependency> <groupId>io.micrometer</groupId> <artifactId>micrometer-core</artifactId></dependency><!-- Micrometer Prometheus注册表 - 将Micrometer指标转为Prometheus格式 --><dependency> <groupId>io.micrometer</groupId> <artifactId>micrometer-registry-prometheus</artifactId></dependency><!-- Spring Boot Actuator - 暴露/actuator/prometheus端点 --><dependency> <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId> <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId></dependency>
application.yml配置（实际项目标准配置）： management: endpoints: web: exposure: # 只暴露必要端点，减少安全风险 include: health,info,prometheus,metrics base-path: /actuator endpoint: health: show-details: when-authorized # 授权用户显示详情 prometheus: enabled: true metrics: export: prometheus: enabled: true step: 30s # 指标推送间隔（与scrape_interval对齐） tags: # 全局标签：所有指标都会携带application标签 application: ${spring.application.name} project: smart-mine env: ${spring.profiles.active:dev} distribution: percentiles-histogram: http.server.requests: true # 开启直方图，支持P50/P95/P99计算 slo: http.server.requests: 50ms,100ms,200ms,500ms,1s,3s # 自定义SLO桶边界 web: server: request: autotime: enabled: true percentiles: 0.5,0.95,0.99
2.2 Micrometer指标类型源码分析Micrometer是Spring Boot的指标门面，它定义了四种核心指标类型，理解其底层实现是正确使用的前提： Micrometer 指标类型体系：
Meter (抽象基类)
└── 适用：请求总数、错误总数、任务完成数：
└── 源码：AtomicDouble.increment()保证线程安全
└── 适用：当前在线用户数、线程池活跃数、队列大小：
└── 源码：不存储值，每次采集时回调Supplier获取
└── 适用：请求响应时间、方法执行耗时：
└── 源码：内部维护Histogram+Count+TotalTime └── 支持P50/P95/P99百分位计算 └── DistributionSummary (分布摘要 - 记录值分布) └── 适用：请求体大小、消息大小 └── 源码：与Timer类似，但不记录时间单位
Counter源码关键实现： // Micrometer Counter的核心实现（简化版）public class CumulativeCounter extends AbstractMeter implements Counter { // 使用AtomicDouble保证线程安全的递增操作 private final AtomicDouble count; @Override public void increment(double amount) { if (amount > 0) { // CAS方式递增，保证并发安全 count.addAndGet(amount); } } @Override public double count() { return count.get(); }}
Timer源码关键实现： // Micrometer Timer的核心实现（简化版）public class DistributionTimer implements Timer { private final LongAdder count; // 调用次数 private final LongAdder totalTime; // 总耗时（纳秒） private final Histogram histogram; // 直方图分布 @Override public <T> T record(Supplier<T> supplier) { long start = monotonicClock.monotonicTime(); try { T result = supplier.get(); return result; } finally { long duration = monotonicClock.monotonicTime() - start; record(duration, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS); } } @Override public void record(long amount, TimeUnit unit) { long nanoAmount = TimeUnit.NANSECONDS.convert(amount, unit); count.increment(); totalTime.add(nanoAmount); histogram.recordLong(nanoAmount); // 记录到直方图桶中 } @Override public double percentile(double percentile) { // 从直方图中计算百分位值 return histogram.percentile(percentile); }}
Gauge源码关键实现： // Micrometer Gauge的核心实现（简化版）public class DefaultGauge implements Gauge { // Gauge不存储值，而是持有一个Supplier引用 // 每次Prometheus采集时调用Supplier获取最新值 private final Supplier<Number> valueSupplier; @Override public double value() { // 实时回调获取值，这是Gauge与Counter的核心区别 Number value = valueSupplier.get(); return value == null ? 0.0 : value.doubleValue(); }}
2.3 自定义业务指标（实际项目实战）@Component@Slf4jpublic class SmartMineBusinessMetrics { private final Counter deviceDataCollectCounter; // 设备数据采集总数 private final Counter deviceDataCollectFailCounter; // 设备数据采集失败数 private final Counter alertPushCounter; // 告警推送总数 private final Counter alertPushFailCounter; // 告警推送失败数 private final Timer deviceDataCollectTimer; // 设备数据采集耗时 private final Timer alertPushTimer; // 告警推送耗时 private final Gauge deviceOnlineGauge; // 当前在线设备数 private final Gauge deviceOfflineGauge; // 当前离线设备数 private final AtomicInteger currentOnlineDevices; // 在线设备计数器 private final AtomicInteger currentOfflineDevices; // 离线设备计数器 private final Counter mineCarDispatchCounter; // 矿车调度次数 private final DistributionSummary sensorDataSize; // 传感器数据大小分布 public SmartMineBusinessMetrics(MeterRegistry registry) { // ========== Counter：设备数据采集计数 ========== deviceDataCollectCounter = Counter.builder("smartmine.device.data.collect.total") .description("设备数据采集总数") .tag("module", "device-data") .register(registry); deviceDataCollectFailCounter = Counter.builder("smartmine.device.data.collect.fail") .description("设备数据采集失败数") .tag("module", "device-data") .register(registry); // ========== Counter：告警推送计数 ========== alertPushCounter = Counter.builder("smartmine.alert.push.total") .description("告警推送总数") .tag("module", "alert-push") .register(registry); alertPushFailCounter = Counter.builder("smartmine.alert.push.fail") .description("告警推送失败数") .tag("module", "alert-push") .register(registry); // ========== Timer：设备数据采集耗时 ========== deviceDataCollectTimer = Timer.builder("smartmine.device.data.collect.duration") .description("设备数据采集耗时") .tag("module", "device-data") .publishPercentiles(0.5, 0.95, 0.99) // 发布P50/P95/P99 .publishPercentileHistogram() // 发布直方图桶 .serviceLevelObjectives( Duration.ofMillis(50), // SLO: 50ms Duration.ofMillis(100), // SLO: 100ms Duration.ofMillis(200), // SLO: 200ms Duration.ofMillis(500) // SLO: 500ms ) .register(registry); // ========== Timer：告警推送耗时 ========== alertPushTimer = Timer.builder("smartmine.alert.push.duration") .description("告警推送耗时") .tag("module", "alert-push") .publishPercentiles(0.5, 0.95, 0.99) .register(registry); // ========== Gauge：设备在线/离线数 ========== currentOnlineDevices = new AtomicInteger(0); currentOfflineDevices = new AtomicInteger(0); deviceOnlineGauge = Gauge.builder("smartmine.device.online.count", currentOnlineDevices, AtomicInteger::get) .description("当前在线设备数") .tag("module", "device-data") .register(registry); deviceOfflineGauge = Gauge.builder("smartmine.device.offline.count", currentOfflineDevices, AtomicInteger::get) .description("当前离线设备数") .tag("module", "device-data") .register(registry); // ========== Counter：矿车调度计数 ========== mineCarDispatchCounter = Counter.builder("smartmine.minecar.dispatch.total") .description("矿车调度次数") .tag("module", "mine-car-dispatch") .register(registry); // ========== DistributionSummary：传感器数据大小 ========== sensorDataSize = DistributionSummary.builder("smartmine.sensor.data.size") .description("传感器数据大小（bytes）") .tag("module", "device-data") .publishPercentiles(0.5, 0.95, 0.99) .register(registry); } // ========== 设备数据采集指标操作 ========== public void recordDeviceDataCollect() { deviceDataCollectCounter.increment(); } public void recordDeviceDataCollectFail() { deviceDataCollectFailCounter.increment(); } public Timer.Sample startCollectTimer() { return Timer.start(); } public void stopCollectTimer(Timer.Sample sample) { sample.stop(deviceDataCollectTimer); } // ========== 告警推送指标操作 ========== public void recordAlertPush() { alertPushCounter.increment(); } public void recordAlertPushFail() { alertPushFailCounter.increment(); } public Timer.Sample startAlertTimer() { return Timer.start(); } public void stopAlertTimer(Timer.Sample sample) { sample.stop(alertPushTimer); } // ========== 设备在线状态指标操作 ========== public void deviceOnline() { currentOnlineDevices.incrementAndGet(); currentOfflineDevices.decrementAndGet(); } public void deviceOffline() { currentOfflineDevices.incrementAndGet(); currentOnlineDevices.decrementAndGet(); } // ========== 矿车调度指标操作 ========== public void recordMineCarDispatch() { mineCarDispatchCounter.increment(); } // ========== 传感器数据大小记录 ========== public void recordSensorDataSize(int sizeBytes) { sensorDataSize.record(sizeBytes); }}
2.4 线程池指标采集@Component@Slf4jpublic class ThreadPoolMetricsRegistrar implements ApplicationContextAware { @Override public void setApplicationContext(ApplicationContext ctx) { // 自动发现并注册所有ThreadPoolExecutor的指标 Map<String, ThreadPoolExecutor> executors = ctx.getBeansOfType(ThreadPoolExecutor.class); MeterRegistry registry = ctx.getBean(MeterRegistry.class); executors.forEach((beanName, executor) -> { String poolName = normalizePoolName(beanName); // 活跃线程数 Gauge.builder("smartmine.threadpool.active", executor, ThreadPoolExecutor::getActiveCount) .tag("pool", poolName) .description("活跃线程数") .register(registry); // 当前线程数 Gauge.builder("smartmine.threadpool.current", executor, ThreadPoolExecutor::getPoolSize) .tag("pool", poolName) .description("当前线程数") .register(registry); // 队列大小 Gauge.builder("smartmine.threadpool.queue.size", executor, e -> e.getQueue().size()) .tag("pool", poolName) .description("队列当前大小") .register(registry); // 队列剩余容量 Gauge.builder("smartmine.threadpool.queue.remaining", executor, e -> e.getQueue().remainingCapacity()) .tag("pool", poolName) .description("队列剩余容量") .register(registry); // 已完成任务数 Gauge.builder("smartmine.threadpool.completed", executor, ThreadPoolExecutor::getCompletedTaskCount) .tag("pool", poolName) .description("已完成任务数") .register(registry); // 核心线程数 Gauge.builder("smartmine.threadpool.core", executor, ThreadPoolExecutor::getCorePoolSize) .tag("pool", poolName) .description("核心线程数") .register(registry); // 最大线程数 Gauge.builder("smartmine.threadpool.max", executor, ThreadPoolExecutor::getMaximumPoolSize) .tag("pool", poolName) .description("最大线程数") .register(registry); log.info("注册线程池指标: pool={}, core={}, max={}", poolName, executor.getCorePoolSize(), executor.getMaximumPoolSize()); }); } private String normalizePoolName(String beanName) { // deviceDataExecutor -> device-data return beanName .replace("Executor", "") .replace("Pool", "") .replaceAll("([a-z])([A-Z])", "$1-$2") .toLowerCase(); }}
2.5 指标在业务代码中的使用@Service@Slf4jpublic class DeviceDataCollectService { @Autowired private SmartMineBusinessMetrics metrics; @Autowired private DeviceSensorDataRepository sensorDataRepository; /** * 采集设备传感器数据 */ public CollectResult collectDeviceData(DeviceCollectRequest request) { Timer.Sample sample = metrics.startCollectTimer(); try { // 1. 从设备端采集数据 List<SensorData> sensorDataList = fetchFromDevice(request.getDeviceId()); // 2. 校验数据完整性 if (CollectionUtils.isEmpty(sensorDataList)) { metrics.recordDeviceDataCollectFail(); return CollectResult.fail("采集数据为空"); } // 3. 批量写入数据库 sensorDataRepository.batchInsert(sensorDataList); // 4. 记录数据大小 sensorDataList.forEach(data -> metrics.recordSensorDataSize(data.getPayload().length)); // 5. 记录成功 metrics.recordDeviceDataCollect(); return CollectResult.success(sensorDataList.size()); } catch (Exception e) { metrics.recordDeviceDataCollectFail(); log.error("设备数据采集失败, deviceId={}", request.getDeviceId(), e); return CollectResult.fail(e.getMessage()); } finally { metrics.stopCollectTimer(sample); } }}
三、Prometheus配置与数据采集3.1 Prometheus核心配置# prometheus.yml — 实际项目完整配置global: scrape_interval: 15s # 全局采集间隔 evaluation_interval: 15s # 规则评估间隔 scrape_timeout: 10s # 采集超时 external_labels: project: 'smart-mine' # 外部标签，联邦查询时区分集群 env: 'production' cluster: 'smart-mine-prod'# Consul服务发现 — 微服务动态发现scrape_configs: # ========== 微服务应用指标 ========== - job_name: 'smart-mine-services' metrics_path: '/actuator/prometheus' scrape_interval: 15s consul_sd_configs: - server: 'consul:8500' services: # 只发现以下服务 - device-data-service - alert-push-service - mine-car-dispatch-service - safety-monitor-service - gateway-service relabel_configs: # 只采集带有prometheus-scrape=true标签的实例 - source_labels: [__meta_consul_tags] regex: '.*prometheus-scrape.*' action: keep # 将Consul的ServiceAddress映射为__address__ - source_labels: [__meta_consul_service_address, __meta_consul_service_port] regex: '([^:]+):?(\d+)' replacement: '${1}:${2}' target_label: __address__ # 将Consul的Service名称映射为application标签 - source_labels: [__meta_consul_service] target_label: application # ========== 基础设施指标 ========== - job_name: 'node-exporter' scrape_interval: 15s static_configs: - targets: - 'node-exporter-01:9100' - 'node-exporter-02:9100' - 'node-exporter-03:9100' labels: group: 'infrastructure' # ========== 中间件指标 ========== - job_name: 'mysql-exporter' scrape_interval: 30s static_configs: - targets: ['mysql-exporter:9104'] labels: group: 'middleware' component: 'mysql' - job_name: 'redis-exporter' scrape_interval: 15s static_configs: - targets: ['redis-exporter:9121'] labels: group: 'middleware' component: 'redis' - job_name: 'kafka-exporter' scrape_interval: 30s static_configs: - targets: ['kafka-exporter:9308'] labels: group: 'middleware' component: 'kafka' # ========== 黑盒探针（接口可用性监控） ========== - job_name: 'blackbox-http' scrape_interval: 30s metrics_path: /probe params: module: [http_2xx] static_configs: - targets: - http://device-data-service:8080/actuator/health - http://alert-push-service:8080/actuator/health - http://safety-monitor-service:8080/actuator/health relabel_configs: - source_labels: [__address__] target_label: __param_target - source_labels: [__param_target] target_label: instance - target_label: __address__ replacement: blackbox-exporter:9115 # ========== Pushgateway（临时任务指标） ========== - job_name: 'pushgateway' honor_labels: true # 保留Pushgateway推送时的标签 static_configs: - targets: ['pushgateway:9091']# 告警规则文件rule_files: - 'alert_rules/*.yml'# 远程写入（长期存储）# remote_write:# - url: 'http://thanos-receive:19291/api/v1/receive'# queue_config:# capacity: 10000# max_samples_per_send: 500
3.2 服务发现机制对比架构流程： flowchart TD N1["MySQL 主要使用 不使用 不使用 Redis等 微服务发现"] N2["服务发现方式"] N3["配置复杂度"] N4["动态性"] N5["依赖组件"] N6["实际项目使用场景"] N7["------------"] N8["-----------"] N9["--------"] N10["---------"] N11["-------------------"] N12["static_configs"] N13["低"] N14["静态"] N15["无"] N16["NodeMySQLRedisKafka Exporter"] N17["consul_sd_configs"] N18["中"] N19["动态"] N20["Consul"] N21["Spring Cloud微服务实例"] N22["kubernetes_sd_configs"] N23["高"] N24["K8s API"] N25["未使用非K8s部署"] N26["file_sd_configs"] N27["半动态"] N28["文件"] N29["未使用"] N30["dns_sd_configs"] N31["DNS"] N2 --> N3 N3 --> N4 N4 --> N5 N5 --> N6 N7 --> N8 N8 --> N9 N9 --> N10 N10 --> N11 N12 --> N13 N13 --> N14 N14 --> N15 N15 --> N16 N17 --> N18 N18 --> N19 N19 --> N20 N20 --> N21 N22 --> N23 N23 --> N19 N19 --> N24 N24 --> N25 N26 --> N13 N13 --> N27 N27 --> N28 N28 --> N29 N30 --> N13 N13 --> N19 N19 --> N31 N31 --> N29
3.3 Prometheus数据存储原理–storage.tsdb.retention.time=30d ← 数据保留30天–storage.tsdb.retention.size=50GB ← 磁盘上限50GB–storage.tsdb.min-block-duration=2h ← 最小block时长–storage.tsdb.max-block-duration=2h ← 最大block时长
四、PromQL查询语言深度解析4.1 PromQL核心概念PromQL是Prometheus的查询语言，是Grafana面板和告警规则的基础。理解PromQL是构建有效监控的前提：
概念 说明 示例
即时向量 某一时刻的样本值集合 http_server_requests_seconds_count
范围向量 一段时间内的样本值集合 http_server_requests_seconds_count[5m]
偏移量 查询历史时间点的数据 http_server_requests_seconds_count offset 1h
标签选择器 按标签过滤时间序列 {application="device-data-service", status=~"5.."}
聚合操作 对多维数据进行聚合 sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (application)
4.2 实际项目常用PromQL服务健康与性能指标： # ========== 服务可用性 ==========# 服务是否在线（1=在线，0=离线）up{job="smart-mine-services"}# 在线服务数量count(up{job="smart-mine-services"} == 1)# 离线服务列表up{job="smart-mine-services"} == 0# ========== 请求速率 (QPS) ==========# 各服务每秒请求量sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application!=""}[5m])) by (application)# 总QPSsum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count[5m]))# ========== 错误率 ==========# 5xx错误率（各服务）sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (application)/sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application!=""}[5m])) by (application)* 100# ========== 响应时间 ==========# P50响应时间histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application!=""}[5m])) by (application, le))# P95响应时间histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application!=""}[5m])) by (application, le))# P99响应时间histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application!=""}[5m])) by (application, le))# ========== 设备数据采集专项 ==========# 设备数据采集QPSrate(smartmine_device_data_collect_total[5m])# 设备数据采集失败率rate(smartmine_device_data_collect_fail[5m])/rate(smartmine_device_data_collect_total[5m])* 100# 设备数据采集P99耗时histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(smartmine_device_data_collect_duration_bucket[5m]))# 设备在线率smartmine_device_online_count/(smartmine_device_online_count + smartmine_device_offline_count)* 100
JVM指标查询： # ========== JVM内存 ==========# 堆内存使用率jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="heap", application!=""}/jvm_memory_max_bytes{area="heap", application!=""}* 100# 非堆内存使用jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="nonheap", application!=""}# ========== GC ==========# Young GC频率（次/分钟）rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_count{action="end of minor GC"}[5m]) * 60# Full GC频率（次/分钟）rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_count{action="end of major GC"}[5m]) * 60# GC耗时占比rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_sum[5m])/rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_count[5m])* 1000# ========== 线程 ==========# 活跃线程数jvm_threads_live_threads{application!=""}# 死锁线程数jvm_threads_states_threads{state="blocked", application!=""}
线程池指标查询： # 线程池使用率smartmine_threadpool_active{application!=""}/smartmine_threadpool_max{application!=""}* 100# 队列使用率smartmine_threadpool_queue_size{application!=""}/(smartmine_threadpool_queue_size{application!=""} + smartmine_threadpool_queue_remaining{application!=""})* 100
4.3 Recording Rules（预计算规则）对于复杂的PromQL查询，每次实时计算会消耗大量资源。通过Recording Rules预先计算并存储结果，查询时直接读取即可： # recording_rules.yml — 实际项目预计算规则groups: - name: smartmine_http_metrics interval: 30s rules: # 预计算：各服务QPS - record: smartmine:http_requests:rate5m expr: sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application!=""}[5m])) by (application) # 预计算：各服务5xx错误率 - record: smartmine:http_5xx:rate5m expr: | sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (application) / on(application) sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application!=""}[5m])) by (application) # 预计算：各服务P99响应时间 - record: smartmine:http_requests:p99_5m expr: | histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application!=""}[5m])) by (application, le) ) # 预计算：设备数据采集成功率 - record: smartmine:device_collect:success_rate5m expr: | 1 - (rate(smartmine_device_data_collect_fail[5m]) / rate(smartmine_device_data_collect_total[5m])) - name: smartmine_jvm_metrics interval: 30s rules: # 预计算：堆内存使用率 - record: smartmine:jvm_heap:usage_percent expr: | jvm_memory_used_bytes{area="heap", application!=""} / jvm_memory_max_bytes{area="heap", application!=""} * 100 # 预计算：Full GC频率（次/分钟） - record: smartmine:jvm_fullgc:rate_per_min expr: rate(jvm_gc_pause_seconds_count{action="end of major GC"}[5m]) * 60 # 预计算：线程池使用率 - record: smartmine:threadpool:usage_percent expr: | smartmine_threadpool_active{application!=""} / smartmine_threadpool_max{application!=""} * 100
五、告警规则设计5.1 告警规则配置# alert_rules/service-alerts.yml — 服务级告警groups: - name: smart-mine-service-alerts rules: # ========== 服务可用性告警 ========== - alert: ServiceDown expr: up{job="smart-mine-services"} == 0 for: 1m labels: severity: critical project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "服务 {{ $labels.application }} 宕机" description: "实例 {{ $labels.instance }} 已离线超过1分钟" runbook: "1.确认服务进程是否存活 2.查看服务日志 3.检查资源是否充足" # ========== 接口性能告警 ========== - alert: HighErrorRate expr: | smartmine:http_5xx:rate5m > 0.05 for: 2m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "服务 {{ $labels.application }} 5xx错误率超过5%" description: "当前5xx错误率为 {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}" runbook: "1.查看ELK错误日志 2.SkyWalking链路追踪 3.检查下游服务状态" - alert: HighResponseTime expr: smartmine:http_requests:p99_5m > 1 for: 5m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "服务 {{ $labels.application }} P99响应时间超过1秒" description: "当前P99响应时间 {{ $value }}s" runbook: "1.SkyWalking查看慢调用 2.检查是否有慢SQL 3.检查线程池是否满" - alert: CriticalResponseTime expr: smartmine:http_requests:p99_5m > 3 for: 2m labels: severity: critical project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "服务 {{ $labels.application }} P99响应时间超过3秒（严重）" description: "当前P99响应时间 {{ $value }}s，严重影响用户体验" # ========== JVM健康告警 ========== - alert: HighJVMMemory expr: smartmine:jvm_heap:usage_percent > 85 for: 5m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "服务 {{ $labels.application }} 堆内存使用率超过85%" description: "当前堆内存使用率 {{ $value }}%" runbook: "1.jmap -histo:live查看大对象 2.检查是否有内存泄漏 3.考虑重启释放" - alert: JVMMemoryCritical expr: smartmine:jvm_heap:usage_percent > 95 for: 2m labels: severity: critical project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "服务 {{ $labels.application }} 堆内存使用率超过95%（即将OOM）" - alert: FrequentFullGC expr: smartmine:jvm_fullgc:rate_per_min > 1 for: 3m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "服务 {{ $labels.application }} Full GC频率超过1次/分钟" description: "当前Full GC频率 {{ $value }}次/分钟" runbook: "1.jstat确认老年代使用率 2.jmap -histo:live查看大对象 3.检查是否有内存泄漏" # ========== 线程池告警 ========== - alert: ThreadPoolFull expr: smartmine:threadpool:usage_percent > 80 for: 3m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "线程池 {{ $labels.pool }} 使用率超过80%" description: "当前使用率 {{ $value }}%" # ========== 业务指标告警 ========== - alert: DeviceHighOfflineRate expr: | smartmine_device_offline_count / (smartmine_device_online_count + smartmine_device_offline_count) > 0.2 for: 5m labels: severity: critical project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "设备离线率超过20%" description: "当前离线 {{ $value }} 台设备" runbook: "1.检查设备网络 2.检查数据采集服务状态 3.联系现场确认设备状态" - alert: AlertPushFailRateHigh expr: | rate(smartmine_alert_push_fail[5m]) / rate(smartmine_alert_push_total[5m]) > 0.1 for: 3m labels: severity: critical project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "安全告警推送失败率超过10%" description: "当前告警推送失败率 {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}" runbook: "1.检查钉钉webhook是否正常 2.检查告警服务日志 3.这是安全问题，需紧急处理"
# alert_rules/infrastructure-alerts.yml — 基础设施告警groups: - name: smart-mine-infrastructure-alerts rules: # ========== 系统资源告警 ========== - alert: HighCPU expr: 100 - (avg by (instance) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[5m])) * 100) > 90 for: 5m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "节点 {{ $labels.instance }} CPU使用率超过90%" - alert: HighMemory expr: (1 - (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes)) * 100 > 90 for: 5m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "节点 {{ $labels.instance }} 内存使用率超过90%" - alert: DiskSpaceLow expr: (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{mountpoint="/"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{mountpoint="/"}) * 100 < 15 for: 10m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "节点 {{ $labels.instance }} 磁盘剩余空间不足15%" # ========== MySQL告警 ========== - alert: MySQLTooManyConnections expr: mysql_global_status_threads_connected / mysql_global_variables_max_connections > 0.8 for: 3m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "MySQL连接数使用率超过80%" - alert: MySQLSlowQueries expr: increase(mysql_global_status_slow_queries[5m]) > 10 for: 2m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "MySQL 5分钟内慢查询超过10条" # ========== Redis告警 ========== - alert: RedisMemoryHigh expr: redis_memory_used_bytes / redis_memory_max_bytes > 0.85 for: 5m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "Redis内存使用率超过85%" - alert: RedisConnectedClientsHigh expr: redis_connected_clients / redis_config_maxclients > 0.8 for: 3m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "Redis连接数使用率超过80%" # ========== Kafka告警 ========== - alert: KafkaConsumerLagHigh expr: kafka_consumergroup_lag > 10000 for: 5m labels: severity: warning project: smart-mine annotations: summary: "Kafka消费者组 {{ $labels.consumergroup }} Lag超过10000"
5.2 告警分级策略架构流程： flowchart TD N1["短信"] N2["钉钉 升级5分钟未响应升级至CTO"] N3["钉钉 升级2小时未处理升级至技术负责人"] N4["日常巡检关注"] N1 --> N2 N2 --> N1 N1 --> N3 N2 --> N3 N3 --> N4
5.3 告警规则源码分析——Prometheus评估引擎// Prometheus告警规则的评估流程（简化版源码分析）// 源码位置: rules/manager.gotype AlertingRule struct { name string // 规则名称 vector Expr // PromQL表达式 holdDuration time.Duration // for持续时间 labels labels.Labels // 规则标签 annotations labels.Labels // 注解 active map[uint64]*Alert // 活跃告警集合（key为指纹hash）}// 评估入口：每次evaluation_interval触发一次func (r *AlertingRule) Eval(ctx context.Context, ts time.Time) { // 1. 执行PromQL表达式，获取当前值 vector := r.vector.Eval(ctx) // 2. 对比每个时间序列的结果 for _, sample := range vector { fingerprint := sample.Metric.Hash() if sample.V > 0 { // 表达式成立（条件满足） if alert, exists := r.active[fingerprint]; exists { // 已存在：检查是否超过for持续时间 if ts.Sub(alert.ActiveAt) >= r.holdDuration { alert.State = StateFiring // 超过for时间，触发告警 } else { alert.State = StatePending // 还在for等待期 } } else { // 新产生：创建Pending状态的告警 r.active[fingerprint] = &Alert{ State: StatePending, ActiveAt: ts, Labels: sample.Metric, } } } else { // 表达式不成立（条件不满足） if alert, exists := r.active[fingerprint]; exists { // 移除活跃告警（恢复正常） delete(r.active, fingerprint) } } } // 3. 将Firing状态的告警发送给AlertManager var alerts []*Alert for _, alert := range r.active { if alert.State == StateFiring { alerts = append(alerts, alert) } } r.sendAlerts(alerts)}
关键设计理解：
概念 说明 实战意义
for 持续时间 条件必须持续满足才触发 避免瞬时波动触发告警，实际项目建议P0告警for=1m，P1告警for=3-5m
Pending状态 条件满足但未超过for时间 可在Grafana中观察Pending告警，提前预判
Firing状态 条件持续满足，已触发 发送至AlertManager
指纹（Fingerprint） 标签集合的哈希值 同一标签组合的告警只会有一条
恢复 条件不再满足时自动消除 AlertManager会发送恢复通知
六、AlertManager告警通知6.1 AlertManager配置# alertmanager.yml — 实际项目告警通知配置global: resolve_timeout: 5m # 告警恢复通知超时# 告警路由树route: receiver: 'dingtalk-default' # 默认接收者 group_wait: 30s # 首次等待时间（等同组其他告警一起发） group_interval: 5m # 同组新告警的等待时间 repeat_interval: 1h # 重复告警间隔 # 子路由：按severity分级 routes: # P0-Critical：电话+短信+钉钉，10分钟重复 - match: severity: critical receiver: 'dingtalk-critical' repeat_interval: 10m group_wait: 10s # 继续子路由：设备离线类告警单独分组 routes: - match: alertname: DeviceHighOfflineRate receiver: 'dingtalk-critical-device' group_by: ['alertname', 'project'] # P1-Warning：短信+钉钉，30分钟重复 - match: severity: warning receiver: 'dingtalk-warning' repeat_interval: 30m # P2-Info：仅钉钉，2小时重复 - match: severity: info receiver: 'dingtalk-info' repeat_interval: 2h# 告警抑制规则：高级别告警抑制低级别告警inhibit_rules: # 服务宕机时，抑制该服务的所有其他告警 - source_match: severity: 'critical' alertname: 'ServiceDown' target_match: severity: 'warning' equal: ['application', 'instance'] # P0告警抑制P1告警 - source_match: severity: 'critical' target_match: severity: 'warning' equal: ['application']# 静默规则示例（通过API动态设置）# silences:# - matchers:# - alertname = PlannedMaintenance# starts_at: 2024-06-15T22:00:00# ends_at: 2024-06-16T06:00:00# created_by: admin@smart-mine.com# comment: "计划维护窗口"# 接收者配置receivers: - name: 'dingtalk-default' webhook_configs: - url: 'http://alertmanager-webhook:8060/dingtalk/default' send_resolved: true # 发送恢复通知 - name: 'dingtalk-critical' webhook_configs: - url: 'http://alertmanager-webhook:8060/dingtalk/critical' send_resolved: true - name: 'dingtalk-critical-device' webhook_configs: - url: 'http://alertmanager-webhook:8060/dingtalk/critical-device' send_resolved: true - name: 'dingtalk-warning' webhook_configs: - url: 'http://alertmanager-webhook:8060/dingtalk/warning' send_resolved: true - name: 'dingtalk-info' webhook_configs: - url: 'http://alertmanager-webhook:8060/dingtalk/info' send_resolved: true

6.3 告警Webhook实现@RestController@RequestMapping("/dingtalk")@Slf4jpublic class AlertWebhookController { @Autowired private DingTalkService dingTalkService; @Autowired private SmsService smsService; /** * 接收AlertManager的Critical级别告警 */ @PostMapping("/critical") public ResponseEntity<Void> criticalAlert(@RequestBody AlertManagerPayload payload) { log.warn("收到Critical告警: {}", payload); for (AlertManagerPayload.Alert alert : payload.getAlerts()) { String severity = alert.getLabels().get("severity"); String alertName = alert.getLabels().get("alertname"); String application = alert.getLabels().get("application"); // P0告警：钉钉+短信+电话 String message = buildAlertMessage(alert, "P0-Critical"); dingTalkService.sendCritical(message); smsService.sendAlertSms(application, alertName, alert.getAnnotations().get("summary")); // 特殊处理：安全告警推送失败，额外通知安全值班人员 if ("AlertPushFailRateHigh".equals(alertName)) { smsService.emergencyCall("安全值班人员", alert.getAnnotations().get("summary")); } // 特殊处理：设备大面积离线，通知现场运维 if ("DeviceHighOfflineRate".equals(alertName)) { smsService.emergencyCall("现场运维", "设备大面积离线，请立即检查"); } } return ResponseEntity.ok().build(); } /** * 接收Warning级别告警 */ @PostMapping("/warning") public ResponseEntity<Void> warningAlert(@RequestBody AlertManagerPayload payload) { log.info("收到Warning告警: {}", payload); for (AlertManagerPayload.Alert alert : payload.getAlerts()) { String message = buildAlertMessage(alert, "P1-Warning"); dingTalkService.sendWarning(message); } return ResponseEntity.ok().build(); } private String buildAlertMessage(AlertManagerPayload.Alert alert, String level) { Map<String, String> labels = alert.getLabels(); Map<String, String> annotations = alert.getAnnotations(); StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(); sb.append(level).append(" | 智慧矿山监控告警\n"); sb.append("─────────────────\n"); sb.append("告警名称: ").append(labels.getOrDefault("alertname", "N/A")).append("\n"); sb.append("影响服务: ").append(labels.getOrDefault("application", "N/A")).append("\n"); sb.append("告警详情: ").append(annotations.getOrDefault("summary", "N/A")).append("\n"); sb.append("触发时间: ").append(alert.getStartsAt()).append("\n"); if (alert.getEndsAt() != null) { sb.append("恢复时间: ").append(alert.getEndsAt()).append("\n"); } sb.append("处理建议: ").append(annotations.getOrDefault("runbook", "无")).append("\n"); sb.append("监控面板: http://grafana.smart-mine.local/d/").append(labels.getOrDefault("application", "")); return sb.toString(); }}

十、监控指标采集全链路源码分析10.1 Spring Boot Actuator指标暴露源码// Spring Boot Actuator自动配置流程（简化版源码分析）// Step 1: 自动配置入口 — MicrometerPrometheusAutoConfiguration@AutoConfiguration(after = MetricsAutoConfiguration.class)@ConditionalOnClass(PrometheusMeterRegistry.class)public class MicrometerPrometheusAutoConfiguration { @Bean @ConditionalOnMissingBean public PrometheusMeterRegistry prometheusMeterRegistry( PrometheusConfig config, CollectorRegistry registry, MeterRegistry... registries) { // 创建Prometheus注册表，将Micrometer指标转为Prometheus格式 return new PrometheusMeterRegistry(config, registry, ConfigurableClock.SYSTEM); }}// Step 2: Actuator端点暴露 — PrometheusScrapeEndpoint@Endpoint(id = "prometheus")public class PrometheusScrapeEndpoint { private final CollectorRegistry collectorRegistry; private final PrometheusMeterRegistry meterRegistry; @ReadOperation(produces = TextFormat.CONTENT_TYPE_OPENMETRICS_0_0_1) public String scrape() { // 1. 遍历所有已注册的Meter（Counter/Gauge/Timer等） // 2. 将每个Meter转为Prometheus格式的时间序列 // 3. 按照OpenMetrics文本格式输出 // // 输出格式示例： // # HELP smartmine_device_data_collect_total 设备数据采集总数 // # TYPE smartmine_device_data_collect_total counter // smartmine_device_data_collect_total{application="device-data-service",module="device-data"} 12345.0 // // # HELP jvm_memory_used_bytes The amount of used memory // # TYPE jvm_memory_used_bytes gauge // jvm_memory_used_bytes{application="device-data-service",area="heap",id="G1 Old Gen"} 2.147483648E8 StringWriter writer = new StringWriter(); TextFormat.writeOpenMetrics100Format( writer, this.collectorRegistry.metricFamilySamples() ); return writer.toString(); }}// Step 3: Micrometer内部指标采集 — JvmMemoryMetricspublic class JvmMemoryMetrics implements MeterRegistry.AutorBindMeter { @Override public void bindTo(MeterRegistry registry) { // 通过JMX或Java API获取JVM内存指标 // 注册为Gauge类型 for (MemoryPoolMXBean pool : ManagementFactory.getMemoryPoolMXBeans()) { Gauge.builder("jvm.memory.used", pool, p -> p.getUsage().getUsed()) .tag("id", pool.getName()) .tag("area", isHeap(pool) ? "heap" : "nonheap") .register(registry); Gauge.builder("jvm.memory.max", pool, p -> getMax(pool)) .tag("id", pool.getName()) .tag("area", isHeap(pool) ? "heap" : "nonheap") .register(registry); } }}
10.2 Prometheus拉取指标源码// Prometheus scrape流程源码分析（简化版）// 源码位置: scrape/scrape.gotype ScrapeLoop struct { target *Target // 采集目标 client http.Client // HTTP客户端 interval time.Duration // 采集间隔 timeout time.Duration // 超时时间 scraper scraper // 采集器 appender storage.Appender // 存储写入器}func (sl *ScrapeLoop) run() { ticker := time.NewTicker(sl.interval) defer ticker.Stop() for { select { case <-ticker.C: sl.scrapeAndAppend() case <-sl.done: return } }}func (sl *ScrapeLoop) scrapeAndAppend() { start := time.Now() // 1. 发送HTTP GET请求到 /actuator/prometheus // GET http://device-data-service:8080/actuator/prometheus resp, err := sl.client.Get(sl.target.URL()) if err != nil { sl.reportError(err) return } // 2. 解析OpenMetrics文本格式 // 将文本解析为Sample切片 samples, err := textparse.Parse(resp.Body) if err != nil { sl.reportError(err) return } // 3. 写入TSDB存储 // 每个Sample = {metric_name, labels, value, timestamp} for _, sample := range samples { sl.appender.Add(sample.Labels, sample.Timestamp, sample.Value) } // 4. 提交事务 sl.appender.Commit() // 5. 更新采集指标（scrape_duration_seconds等） sl.reportScrapeDuration(time.Since(start))}
